## SmartBeam beta 1.2.105

- Adds persistent lifetime counters for device runtime, battery runtime, beam breaks, and boots.
- Exposes the counters through a read-only Device Information BLE characteristic for client integration.

## SmartBeam beta 1.2.106

### Fixes

- Keep lifetime-log NVS operations outside FreeRTOS critical sections.
- Count battery runtime correctly when USB connection state changes without an SOC or charging-state change.
